telemetry_name: Audi R8 LMS GT3 Evo II
confidence_notes: Exact real-car research establishes a steering-wheel clutch lever for moving off. Assetto Corsa EVO instead accepted clutch-free move-off, which is recorded as a simulator override. Six gears, clutchless upshifts at sustained full throttle, clutchless downshifts on a closed throttle with an automatic blip, and a GT rim with no display and no shift lights were directly observed. Automatic cut remains unknown because Assetto Corsa EVO publishes no engine torque to SimHub and the cut is ignition-side.
